Matcap: Which matcap to use: clay, chrome, pearl, toon, jade, gold, bone, blackglass are generated. custom uses the image on in1.
Tint: Colour multiplied into the matcap, scaled by Tintamount.
Tintamount: Blend between the plain matcap (0) and the matcap multiplied by Tint (1).
Brightness: Output gain applied to the matcap colour. 1 = unchanged.
Rotate: Rotates the matcap lookup in degrees, moving the highlights around the object.
Flipy: Flips the matcap lookup vertically, so light comes from the other side.
Spinmatcap: Whole revolutions of the matcap lookup per preview cycle. 0 = static; negative values spin the other way.
Modamount: Scales the in2 modulation CHOP. band1 adds to Brightness, band2 rotates the matcap. 0 = ignore it.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Turns: Number of full turns the preview shapes make per animation cycle. 0 = static.
Background: Background colour of the preview render.
Camdistance: Distance of the preview camera in world units.
Showtorus: Show the torus in the preview render.
Showsphere: Show the sphere in the preview render.
